name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app, installed the CopilotKit runtime, and created the API route. The copilot endpoint is demonstrably working: `curl /api/copilotkit/info` returned valid JSON showing `{"version":"1.69.0","agents":{"default":{"name":"default","className":"BuiltInAgent"...}}`. However, the frontend is blocked because `@copilotkit/react-core/v2` cannot be resolved—the `node_modules/@copilotkit/react-core/` directory is empty despite `npm install` completing successfully, causing the root page to 500 with a module-not-found error. I also had to deviate from the docs by using a placeholder `OPENAI_API_KEY` since no API credentials were actually exported in the sandbox environment.
